userAgentParser.q1: What information does a User-Agent string contain?
userAgentParser.a1: A User-Agent string provides details regarding the client browser application, rendering engine, operating system platform, CPU architecture, and device form factor.
userAgentParser.q2: Can this parser differentiate human browsers from bots and AI scrapers?
userAgentParser.a2: Yes. The parser maintains signature patterns for search engine bots (Googlebot, Bingbot), social crawlers, and AI scraping agents (OpenAI GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, ByteDance ByteSpider).
userAgentParser.q3: Is my User-Agent string sent to any external server?
userAgentParser.a3: No. The parsing engine executes 100% locally inside your browser memory without sending data to external APIs.
userAgentParser.q4: What does RFC compliant mean for a User-Agent?
userAgentParser.a4: RFC 7231 specifies that HTTP user agents should begin with product identifier tokens (like Mozilla/5.0) and maintain clean token formatting without illegal characters.
